plan.question: Can fixed rule-roster counts change opportunity ranks, not just scale?
plan.rosters: all equal per-owner counts n=2..floor(area/2); own actor conditioned present
plan.A: iid remaining density d=(2n-1)/(area-1), enemy d/2, empty 1-d
plan.B: same iid occupancy d, enemy n/(area-1), friend (n-1)/(area-1)
plan.C: uniform fixed counts n-1 friend,n enemy,area-2n empty over remaining cells
plan.decision: Strict rank reversal means count law is a separate candidate axis; otherwise inspect ratio-only sensitivity. No product/default or utility claim.
plan.validation: A vs existing analytic mobility and semantic cannon; C vs independent full 3x3 occupancy enumeration
plan.scope: Uniform source, simple quiet/target capture and one-screen orthogonal cannon. Anchor safety, reachable-state law, promotion/drop/auxiliary effects and price calibration excluded explicitly; full generic target unchanged.
